entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request establishment of a secure connection to the network for user data transfer or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to initiate the service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: Pending user data or signaling
entities.description: Condition where the UE has pending uplink user data or signaling to send.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Service request procedure is triggered when UE has pending uplink user data or signaling.
